profile.headline: Application Development Engineer II at Centene Pharmacy Solutions
profile.summary: I graduated from University of Phoenix with a Bachelor of Science degree in Information Technology. I have been happily working as a Software Developer since 2012. I look forward to keeping up with the latest technologies, and to hone my skills as a Software Developer.
